vehicle: 2026 Porsche 911 Turbo S Cabriolet · Gentian Blue Metallic
measurementScope: Verified applies to the named, visible checkpoints in the frame. All 62 matched images were rendered in the shipped WebGL viewer at native reference dimensions. Other entries are reference-only. Per-frame silhouette distances use the bidirectional nearest outer boundary on a 1280 × 720 grid and are reported at 3840 px width. The outline overlay also shows geometric normal and depth discontinuities, sampled at 1456 px width and scaled to the native image. Studio lighting and material accuracy are assessed separately.

side.reference: Porsche - Turbo S Cabriolet side view.png

side.configuration: Factory photo shows black bodywork, contrasting top cover and different wheel finish.

frames.label: Powertrain · 3.6L twin-eTurbo flat-6 engine (rear view)
frames.note: The opposed cylinder banks, lower engine carrier and two eTurbo inlets are identifiable. The back of the castings and concealed hose paths are inferred. Surface detail uses Porsche’s rear and three-quarter photographs. Visible assembly mask overlap 85.5%.

frames.label: Powertrain · 3.6L twin-eTurbo engine & titanium exhaust (rear 3/4)
frames.note: The engine, outboard exhaust housings and transverse silencer are independent meshes. The ends of the heat shields and the flanges differ from the photographed unit. Visible assembly mask overlap 87.2%.

frames.label: Powertrain · 8-speed hybrid PDK (CDU.50) & 60 kW PMSM electric motor
frames.note: The separated electric motor and ribbed PDK case follow the illustration. Phase leads are modeled and the visible case carries photographic surface detail. Rear motor casing and internal tooth profiles are approximate. Visible assembly mask overlap 84.8%.

frames.label: Powertrain · Rolling chassis, AWD & 400V HV routing (front-left 3/4)
frames.note: Wheelbase, powertrain location and the longitudinal electrical route register in this view. The small brackets, hose bundles, battery housing and unpictured faces are simplified. Visible assembly mask overlap 79.6%.

frames.label: Cabin · Dashboard, curved digital cluster & console
